# Catto Learning Theme Package Specification

**Generated by:** ChatGPT  
**Date time:** 2026/08/12 02:45 SAST  
**LMS version:** 0.5.4  
**Package schema:** 1.0

## Purpose

A Catto Learning theme is a portable ZIP package described by an authoritative root `theme.json`. The package can be validated, imported as a draft, previewed without affecting the live site, activated, edited in Theme Studio and exported back to a portable ZIP.

## Minimum valid package

A package must contain at least:

```text
theme.json
templates/base.html
css/style.css
```

`theme.json` must declare at least one stylesheet and a base `.html` template. The base template must render `{{ @page_content | raw }}`. `style.css` is the conventional default filename, not a hard-coded requirement.

## No executable PHP

Theme packages may not contain or execute PHP, PHTML, PHAR, shell scripts or other server executable code. Server-side presentation uses HTML with Fat-Free Framework template syntax. JavaScript executes only in the browser.

## Manifest

The manifest identifies metadata and every structural resource the LMS should load. Core fields are:

- `format`: `catto-learning-theme`
- `schema_version`: `1.0`
- `theme`: name, slug, version, author, generator, SAST/offset timestamp and description
- `templates`: base plus optional header/footer/sidebar and future named template roles
- `pages`: optional page-type overrides
- `stylesheets`: one or more CSS files, loaded in array order
- `scripts`: zero or more JavaScript files, loaded in array order
- `assets`: declared binary image/font assets
- `external`: explicitly declared HTTPS CDN stylesheets/scripts
- `palettes`, `active_palette`, `design`: visual-editor state
- `advanced_css`: optional separate CSS file that loads last

The bundled JSON Schema is `resources/schema/catto-learning-theme-1.0.schema.json`.

## Storage model

On import, text resources (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON/text) are stored in PostgreSQL theme records. Binary image/font files are stored in private filesystem storage with path, media type, SHA-256, size and theme ownership recorded in PostgreSQL. Preview/live materialisation produces only the browser-accessible assets required to render the selected snapshot.

## Page overrides

A package may declare page overrides such as `home`, `catalogue`, `course`, `library`, `profile`, `admin-control-centre` or future page keys supported by the renderer. If an override is absent, Catto Learning falls back to its standard page template.

## F3 template contract

Theme HTML can use Fat-Free Framework template constructs such as `{{ ... }}`, `<check>`, `<repeat>` and `<include>`. The base template must expose the LMS page body via `@page_content`. Themes should use LMS-provided variables rather than duplicating application/business logic.

## Visual-editor hooks

To participate in Theme Studio layout controls, custom markup should expose these stable hooks where applicable:

- `data-theme-nav` — primary navigation container
- `data-nav-item="home|catalogue|help|company|account|administration|signout"` — reorderable/hideable navigation items
- `data-theme-breadcrumb` — breadcrumb/context-bar surface
- `data-theme-hero` — front-page hero component

For navigation reordering to work predictably, the `data-nav-item` elements should be siblings in the same flex/grid ordering container. A theme remains valid without optional hooks; controls for markup that the theme does not expose cannot affect that component.

## Colour and gradient policy

Theme palettes and semantic colour roles use explicit hexadecimal colours, with automatic safe-contrast foreground roles available for common text/background pairs. CSS gradients are permitted in package stylesheets and Advanced Custom CSS when they are an intentional part of the theme design—for example metallic gilt edges, decorative rules, progress fills or illustration effects. Theme Studio semantic roles remain solid colours so palette editing stays predictable.

## CSS precedence

The contractual order is:

1. package/base stylesheets;
2. Catto Learning functional platform overrides needed for safe/usable core controls;
3. Theme Studio generated semantic/layout CSS variables and rules;
4. Advanced Custom CSS.

Advanced Custom CSS therefore wins. Theme Studio never rewrites a package stylesheet or Advanced Custom CSS.

## External resources

CDN resources must be listed explicitly in `external.stylesheets` or `external.scripts` and must use HTTPS. The importer does not infer or silently trust arbitrary remote resources found in HTML.

## Security and package limits

The 1.0 importer rejects unsafe paths, traversal, unsupported executable/resource types, PHP processing instructions in templates, undeclared manifest files, missing required resources and over-size archives/files. Current limits are 500 files, 10 MB per file and 50 MB uncompressed per package.

## Draft, preview and activation

Import creates a draft. Draft editing and preview use an isolated draft materialisation and do not modify the live active snapshot. **Save draft** saves work; **Activate / Apply draft** is the explicit operation that publishes that theme snapshot live.

## Export

Export reconstructs a complete portable ZIP from PostgreSQL text/configuration and filesystem assets, regenerating an authoritative `theme.json`. A theme built entirely in Theme Studio is therefore transferable to another Catto Learning installation.
